replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: I’ve always found math practical but challenging. My favorite subjects are chemistry and economics, which I apply daily through gardening and budgeting. I don’t have formal education, so I learn by doing—like calculating crop yields or tracking expenses. Math helps me solve real-world problems without needing advanced theory.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: I don’t get anxious about math itself, but I do worry when it feels too abstract or disconnected from real life. My low agreeableness and moderate neuroticism mean I prefer hands-on tasks over theoretical puzzles. I’ve used simple tools like spreadsheets to keep math practical and stress-free.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used AI tools like chatbots to check my math homework. It helped me understand basic concepts quickly, but I struggled with complex topics. My limited education means I need clear, step-by-step explanations—AI was useful for simple problems but not for deeper analysis.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, write the equation in standard form: ax² + bx + c = 0. Then, calculate the discriminant (b² - 4ac). If it’s positive, there are two real solutions; if zero, one solution; if negative, complex solutions. Use the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √(discriminant)] / (2a). I focus on practical examples, like budgeting, to make it relatable.

To find stationary points, take the first derivative f’(x), set it equal to zero, and solve for x. Then, plug those x-values back into f(x) to get the y-coordinates. For example, if f(x) = x², f’(x) = 2x, so x = 0 is a stationary point. I use this for gardening—like finding the peak of a plant’s growth curve.

replies.According to you, how can LLMs be used t: LLMs can help students with step-by-step explanations for basic math, like budgeting or gardening calculations. For example, an LLM could guide a student through simple algebra using real-life examples, making math less intimidating and more relevant.
